subject: MAP kickoff: Arbor Labs evaluation & procurement plan
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@arbor-labs.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@arbor-labs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: Arbor Labs evaluation & procurement plan

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on roles, milestones, and the contracting path to close the POC and GA license. I attached a first-pass MAP (Arbor_MAP_v1.pdf) and a draft SOW for reference.

High-level proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (Jun 22): Finalize MAP owners + acceptance criteria for POC
- Week 2 (Jun 29): Technical onboarding and trial config
- Week 3 (Jul 6): Evaluation wrap, success review
- Target signature: Week of Jul 6–10 (aiming for 2026-07-08)

Key asks from your side:
1) Please confirm who at Arbor owns legal/terms redlines and procurement approvals (name + email).
2) Any non-standard contracting requirements (data residency, DPA, insurance limits) we should include up front?
3) Preferred process for redlines (DocuSign vs. markups in Word + return) and any internal procurement deadlines.

Internal owners from Redwood:
- Commercial lead: Aisha Rahman (me) — overall MAP coordinator
- Contract/terms lead: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai) — will handle redlines and counterparty legal coordination
- Procurement/finance: Lauren Bishop — billing & PO coordination
- Sales/ops support: Ben Carter — will own SOW finalization and signature logistics

Next steps: if you can reply with your legal and procurement POCs and confirm the signature target window, Neha will follow up with a redline plan and we can schedule a 30-min legal sync if useful.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: Arbor_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft)
Attach: Redwood_SOW_Draft.docx (SOW draft)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@arbor-labs.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@arbor-labs.com>, procure@arbor-labs.com
Date: 2026-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Arbor Labs evaluation & procurement plan

Aisha — thanks for the clear plan and the docs. Good to have an explicit MAP.

On internal owners:
- Legal/terms owner: Martin Cole <mcole@arbor-labs.com> (will lead redlines)
- Procurement owner: Anna Lee <anna.lee@arbor-labs.com> (procurement & PO)
- Commercial sponsor: Priya Shah (cc'd)

Two quick notes from our side:
1) We typically do initial redlines in Word and then move to DocuSign for signature, but Martin will confirm if legal prefers track-changes or a redline summary.
2) We will need a short DPA addendum checked early — can Redwood share your standard DPA? If you have a short template or redlineable clause set, that will speed review.

Target timeline looks reasonable for us; Anna notes a vendor review window that usually takes 7–10 business days once legal and procurement have redlines. Would it help for Neha and Martin to do a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to align on approach?

—Oliver
Director, Infrastructure Solutions | Arbor Labs
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@arbor-labs.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Arbor Labs evaluation & procurement plan

Thanks — quick operational note from Redwood side:
- Neha will own the legal redline queue and will circulate a marked-up set of our standard terms by end of day Mon (2026-06-22) if we get confirmation on the points you mentioned.
- We usually accept track-changes and a redline summary; once both sides align, we convert to DocuSign for signatures.
- I'll drop the SOW final version (Redwood_SOW_Final.docx) into the thread by EOD Mon so procurement has the final scope for PO purposes.

If Martin and Neha are available for a 20-min sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT, that could remove a back-and-forth. Otherwise we can run asynchronously.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attach: Redwood_SOW_Final.docx (to follow)

Thanks all — confirming internal owners and next steps:
- Legal: Martin Cole (cc'd) will handle terms and will review your standard DPA; Martin, Neha — please coordinate.
- Procurement: Anna Lee (cc'd) will manage PO and vendor setup.

We prefer DocuSign for final execution. Here is a placeholder signing link we'll use once both sides confirm the final doc: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCDE-ARB-2026

Target: we'll aim to complete legal + procurement review by end of next week (2026-07-02), which aligns with your Jul 6–10 signature window. If anything slips, Anna will escalate internally.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to schedule the short sync if helpful.

Best,
Priya Shah
